target_buyer_1.why_top_candidate: Official housing authority serving Ashtabula County with Section 8 vouchers (HCV Program), public housing, and USDA housing programs. Mission: 'Provide Ashtabula county residents clean and safe affordable housing.' Strives for strong relationships with residents and community stakeholders. Serves families with honesty, dignity, and respect. Offers exceptional communication, care, responsiveness. Manages significant affordable housing inventory. Would benefit greatly from centralized availability finder and streamlined application portal for HCV, landlords, public housing, USDA housing programs.

target_buyer_2.why_top_candidate: Small apartment community in Ashtabula, Ohio. Positioning: 'Quality, Affordable Living' and 'Quality, Affordable Apartments In Ashtabula.' Located just off State Route 11, minutes from Interstate 90. Quiet, country-like setting close to city. Structured application process: $50 non-refundable fee per applicant, 2-5 business day approval process, 48-hour holding deposit deadline. Strict policies: 6 months rental history required, no pets (service animals only), non-smoking facility, felony conviction = automatic denial. Would benefit from automated availability tracking and tenant pre-screening tools.

ridgeview_estates.name: Ridgeview Estates
ridgeview_estates.description: Small apartment community in beautiful lake shore community of Ashtabula Ohio. Clean, quality, affordable apartments in quiet, country-like setting minutes from city. Located just off State Route 11, few minutes from Interstate 90.

application_process.step1: Each occupant 18+ fills out application with valid ID
application_process.step2: Bring completed forms to office with $50 non-refundable fee per applicant (Check or Money Order only)
application_process.step4: 48 hours to bring holding deposit if approved
application_process.payment_note: NO CASH/CARDS - Cashier's Check or Money Order Only

policies.pets: Not allowed unless registered service animal
policies.smoking: Non-smoking facility, smoking 15+ feet from common entry
policies.parking: First come first serve, max 2 spots per apartment, 4-day limit
policies.rent: By apartment not bed - all tenants equally responsible
policies.felony: Automatic denial - 'Heck NO! We pride ourselves on keeping our residents safe'

ridgeview_estates.visual_style: Quality, affordable, quiet community, strict safety policies
